events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $10.36 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
This is a RydeTAXI trip, so the fare is meter-based and extra kilometres translate directly into extra fare [F1][F6][RD-2]. The trace confirms one off-route segment exists [F3][RD-1]; no percentage or absolute threshold is required for a deviation to count.

The driver's explanation is that AYE was crawling and flooded, so he went around [F8]. For a "reasonable cause" excuse to exempt the segment under RD-4, there must be a traffic incident on the replaced optimal stretch, reported before the detour began and still listed during the trip window [F3][F8][RD-4]. Here no incident at all was recorded near the route [F12], and the trace marks RD-4(a) as failed. The AYE speed band 2 record covers only 08:49–09:12, while the off-route segment ran 09:12–09:26, so it does not even cover the segment and in any event a band record alone does not exempt under the MVP rule [F3][F9][RD-4]. The other roads show moderate bands (30–39 km/h), not severe congestion [F10][F11][RD-4]. Heavy rain [F13] is background context but RD-4 requires documented traffic evidence about the replaced stretch [F3][RD-4].

Consent under RD-5 fails too: there were no in-app messages at all [F7], so there was no driver route-change proposal before leaving the optimal route and no rider agreement to it [F3][RD-5]. RD-3 does not apply because there is no rider-named stop in this case; the trace records no rider stop request before the segment [F3][RD-3].

Amount: RD-2 refunds only the extra kilometres of the non-exempt segment at this trip's per-kilometre rate, $25.77 ÷ 18.3 km = $1.4098/km [F3][F6][RD-2]. The segment added 7.35 km [F3], so 7.35 × $1.4098 = $10.36. The remaining small excess-distance difference (billed $10.68 for 7.6 km [F4]) is map-matching residue not refunded under RD-2 [F3][F4][RD-2]. Waiting was $0.00 and no surge applied, so nothing further is due [F5][F6][RD-2].

Account flag: the driver has no prior upheld route dispute in the last 90 days, so RD-6's condition is not met and no flag_account is warranted; the RD-1 violation is nonetheless recorded [F15][RD-2][RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your trip and found the driver took a detour that wasn't justified by traffic or agreed with you in the app. The detour added about 7.4 km to your fare, so we're refunding the extra distance: $10.36 as a Ryde voucher. The voucher will be added to your account and applies automatically to your next Ryde ride. Nothing else on this trip is affected — your waiting charge was zero and no surge applied. Thanks for flagging this; it helps us keep route quality high.

DRIVER: We reviewed a route dispute on one of your RydeTAXI trips. The trip trace shows one off-route segment, and we couldn't verify a documented traffic incident on the road you would normally have used, or any in-app route-change agreement with the rider. Because of that, we refunded the rider $10.36 in Ryde vouchers for the extra distance, and a shortest-route violation is now recorded on your account. No account suspension or flag applies — you have no other upheld route disputes in the last 90 days. Please use the app to propose a route change before leaving the shortest route, so riders can agree.
